description: Intent i017 (peer-trusted-transport, snapshot s04) complete. FINDING (medium confidence): drivers/hv/hv_balloon.c — Hyper-V host-supplied DM_UNBALLOON_REQUEST consumed with no local cross-checks. Peer-field source: balloon_onchannelcallback() (lines 1475-1519) receives the host message into the static u8 recv_buffer[PAGE_SIZE] (line 506) via vmbus_recvpacket() (1489-1490); the only gate on the DM_UNBALLOON_REQUEST dispatch (1516-1519) is recvlen > 0 (1492) — the peer's hdr.size is never checked against recvlen, whereas the sibling DM_MEM_HOT_ADD_REQUEST handler does check ha_msg->hdr.size == sizeof(struct dm_hot_add) (1527): asymmetric validation between message types of the same host protocol, mirroring the seed's submit-vs-return asymmetry. Missing local limit: balloon_down() takes int range_count = req->range_count (line 1354, quote verified at 1354, range 1350-1362), a raw peer __u32 with no clamp against any maximum or against recvlen, then iterates for (i = 0; i < range_count; i++) free_balloon_pages(dm, &range_array[i]) (1359-1360) — OOB read past the PAGE_SIZE recv_buffer for oversized range_count. Unsafe use: free_balloon_pages() takes num_pages = range_array->finfo.page_cnt (24-bit host field, line 1194) and start_frame = range_array->finfo.start_page (40-bit host PFN, line 1195) and runs for (i = 0; i < num_pages; i++) { pg = pfn_to_page(i + start_frame); __free_page(pg); dm->num_pages_ballooned--; } (1199-1203) — peer-chosen PFNs converted and freed with no pfn_valid() and no membership check against the guest's ballooned-page bookkeeping, plus unsigned counter underflow. Attacker is the hypervisor peer (standard drivers/hv threat model), hence medium confidence. SAFE candidates verified bounded: nbd.c nbd_read_stat (blk_mq tag bounded, bvec per-segment), net/9p/trans_virtio.c req_done (len boolean; tag_len u16), drivers/net/virtio_net.c receive_mergeable num_buf loops (len>truesize rejected, MAX_SKB_FRAGS forces frag_list, xdp_linearize_page PAGE_SIZE check — resolves the site i011 flagged unresolved in s03), fs/cifs/smb2misc.c negotiate-context and data-area clamps, vboxguest copy_to_user min(host,local) size, and the DM_BALLOON_REQUEST allocation path (PAGE_SIZE hdr.size bound). Limitations: xen-blkfront/back, rbd/ceph, smbdirect, 9p fd/rdma/xen transports, hv_kvp/fcopy/snapshot, virtio_scsi, vmw_pvscsi, vhost, vsock only enumerated; no runtime reproducer (read-only tree, needs host-injected vmbus messages); seed usbip code in s04 excluded per seed rule.
